    "date": ["2024-01-01"] * 5,
    "time": ["00:00", "02:00", "04:00", "06:00", "08:00"],

    "is_takeaway": [1] * 5,
    "total": [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Pivot the DataFrame to get the total sales by product and size
